verity_companion.blueprints.header:
Web references (checked 2026-10-28). Minecraft version claimed by every page: 1.21.X.
These are references, not automatic imports. Local templates are original compact designs, not copies of these schematics; compatibility with this modpack is unverified.
verity_companion.structures.header: Original functional templates (not imported schematics). Sizes: small, medium, large. Styles: %s.
verity_companion.structures.footer: Floors may be explicitly 1..32; occupied buildings need height >= floors*4+1 and width/length >=11. Nine floors have 3 clear interior blocks per floor and connected stair landings. Utilities are empty fresh blocks; no stocked inventories, entities, powered machines, crops or fluid systems are promised. Placement remains subject to loaded chunks, build budget, claims and actual completion/undo journal.
